spec_match.rationale: Builds a lazy decode-filter-project pipeline over synthetic log records, counts per-stage work driven by the terminal includes question, and demonstrates the consumed-iterator sharp edge the proposal documents.

interactive.rationale: Record-count slider, code select, Search and the ask-twice button all work; verified E_TIMEOUT found after touching 2,003 of 50,000 records with per-stage call counts, and the double-ask produced true then false with the explanation.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises the lazy pipeline and the wrong-second-answer sharp edge, both delivered with live evidence.

edge_cases.rationale: Early/late/absent targets are selectable, and the iterator-consumption trap is a dedicated interaction with a truth row rather than a footnote.

conformance.rationale: The suite's short-circuit and consumes-the-iterator assertions are this page's exact subject; on Chromium 141 /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail since includes needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): ran a search (2,003/50,000 records touched, 1.7ms, stage table filled) and the ask-twice interaction (true then false, correctly explained); helpers=false logged and the page's stand-in path used; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs per-search produced/total counts and the double-ask outcome.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, secondary button overrides both colours, captioned tables, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled slider with live count, labelled select, captioned tables with scoped headers, aria-live detail.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document scrollWidth is 401px: the code select's long option text ('E_TIMEOUT (common, appears early)') and the two-button row push the stage clip past the right edge, cutting the select, the 'Ask the same iterator twice' button and both tables (mobile screenshot read).

openQuestions.title: Fix the 401px-wide layout at a 360px viewport
openQuestions.detail: The #code select's longest option fixes its intrinsic width and the button row does not shrink, so the page overflows to 401px at 360px and clips the select, the secondary button and the tables' right edges. Give selects max-width:100% (min-width:0 in the flex row), shorten the option labels (the parenthetical can move to the note), and let the buttons wrap; then re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/iterator-includes/log-search/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), which lacks Iterator.prototype.includes; the page's labelled stand-in path kept every lesson intact. Both interactions verified live: the lazy pipeline touched only 2,003 of 50,000 records for an early code with per-stage counts, and asking the same iterator twice produced true then false with the consumed-cursor explanation. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; /conformance/ honestly reported 0 pass / 9 fail. The one real defect is responsive: 401px scrollWidth at 360px with clipped controls, failing mobile parity until the select/button row shrinks.
